name: com.withflintpay/cli
description: Discover and run Flint API operations through five MCP tools, using your CLI credential.

packageArguments.name: --tools
packageArguments.description: Opt into typed tools for comma-separated or repeated operation IDs, dotted resource prefixes, or typed names. Use all for every available operation. Search, describe, and help use the same scope. Omit for five discovery tools.

packageArguments.name: --read-only
packageArguments.description: Expose read operations only and refuse every write.

packageArguments.name: --allow-live
packageArguments.description: Set to true to let tools act on live (production) credentials and contexts. Agents must still acknowledge each live call.

packageArguments.name: --allow-destructive
packageArguments.description: Set to true to let agents confirm destructive operations, and sensitive operations in live mode, themselves. Otherwise the server asks you.

environmentVariables.name: FLINT_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Flint API key. Prefer a sandbox key (flint_test_...). Omit to use a saved flint login.

environmentVariables.name: FLINT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Named Flint CLI profile whose saved credential and configuration to use.

environmentVariables.name: FLINT_MERCHANT
environmentVariables.description: Merchant guard: refuse to run unless the credential belongs to this mer_ ID.

environmentVariables.name: FLINT_ACCESS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Session or partner access token, as an alternative to an API key.
